dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Oh! Dear customer, are you also interested in Anahitian Blessing?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anahitian Blessing?

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Have you never heard of it?

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: It's a specialty from our Sumeru, the grace of Lesser Lord Kusanali!

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: No matter how barren the land or dreadful the climate, a small amount of it shall work wonders!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About this shop...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Syavushi Bakshesh Shoppe only sells specialties from Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Apart from our featured product, Anahitian Blessing, we also have the carefully picked Super Delicious Rukkhashava Mushrooms...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: These specialties all came from Sumeru across the sea. So rest assured, their authenticity is guaranteed!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you! Goodbye!

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Ah, okay. We look forward to your next visit.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is the theory behind that product?

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Um, well... It must be the elemental power within, which grants the land more vitality, and then that, uh...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: *cough* I'm not a researcher, so I can't really explain it well. Anyway, we the Sumeru locals all use this stuff for farming. Its effects are impeccable.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: It's perfect either for your own use or as a gift for your family and friends!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's business going?

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Why would you ask that? Of course...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: ...Ah, never mind. I'll be honest with you.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Before the Sakoku Decree, we still had Inazuma locals coming from Narukami Island to purchase our goods.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: But ever since the Sakoku Decree took effect, only a few people have come. It's getting harder to do business, and I'm not sure how long we can last...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Dear customer, would you like some Anahitian Blessing? How about buying it as a souvenir for your journey here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Eh, no thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Ha, haha...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Ah, indeed, who would buy fertilizers as a souvenir...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's business been?

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Uh... How should I put this?

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: I originally thought that the Sakoku Decree's abolishing would see business pick up, but it hasn't actually improved all that much.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: It's always the same few customers coming to purchase fertilizers. They often forget the method of using the fertilizer to boot...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Well, by the way, dear customer, would you like some Anahitian Blessing? How about buying it as a souvenir for your journey here?
